# Descript Pricing in 2026: Is It Worth Paying For?

Descript sells several plans, and the right one depends on how much you use it. Below is the current lineup, what you get at each tier, and who should (or shouldn't) upgrade. *Prices are approximate and change often — confirm on the official site before buying.*

## Descript Plans at a Glance

| Plan | Price | What You Get |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Free | $0 | limited |
| Creator | $12/mo | 10 hrs/mo |
| Pro | $24/mo | 30 hrs/mo |

## Which Plan Should You Pick?

- **Free / trial:** best for testing the waters. podcasters, video creators can try it without risk.

- **Mid tier ($12/mo):** the sweet spot for most individuals who use Descript regularly.

- **Top tier ($24/mo):** for power users and teams that need the extra limits or seats.


## Is Descript Worth Paying For?

If the transcript-based editor is central to your work — podcasters, video creators — the paid plan pays for itself quickly. If you only need occasional help, the free tier or a cheaper alternative may be enough.

- [[link:/tools/201|Pictory]] — the text-to-video tool
- [[link:/tools/78|Murf AI]] — the AI voiceover studio

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does Descript cost?

Descript starts at $0 and goes up to $24/mo on the top tier. Exact pricing changes, so check the official site.

### Does Descript have a free plan?

Yes — the free tier covers basic use.

### Is Descript worth the money?

For its core audience (podcasters, video creators), yes. Lighter users may be fine on a free or cheaper alternative.
